reproduction.rationale: Both access conditions must use the same complete original 15-participant Figure2A-C panel, actual 10-person control subset, targeting/control source joins, original trial/mask/coordinate identities and complete granular-output verifier. Only the author-code condition adds official code. Existing narrower historical packets and software controls do not provide those authentic manifests, frozen tolerances, source-cluster parity or a matched current episode budget.

improvement.rationale: The unchanged improvement contract has no ordered source-method performance endpoint for biological TMS effect magnitude/significance. No candidate protocol, comparator or authentic same-task superiority evaluator exists. This does not restrict the independent reproduction outcome; no new memory predictor, altered windows or selection rule may substitute for the original task.
